summary: A-F integrity checks pass within read-only, no-qrel-open scope; empirical claims reconcile to raw arrays.

gt_provenance.details: FiQA grades are loaded from pinned BEIR DEV TSV; Nano positive pairs from pinned dataset parquet become explicitly declared binary grade1; TREC labels come from pinned BEIR test.tsv, Git blob/size checked before parsing. These are relevance judgments, not destination-model rankings. Custom graded nDCG/Recall scorer is used, not a claimed official-library invocation. This audit checks code and saved provenance receipts without opening or rehashing qrel contents.

score_normalization.details: nDCG divides DCG by ideal DCG computed from dataset relevance grades; Recall divides retrieved-positive count by all positive judgments. Neither denominator depends on model score max/mean. Auxiliary full_y_retention fields exist in raw summaries, alongside raw metric means; paper tables, figures and cited effects use raw means and differences, not those ratios. Unit-normalized embeddings are retrieval geometry, not metric score normalization.

result_existence.details: 353 ledger entries reconcile to saved scientific files. Main-matrix, ablation, all-paid and prospective mean values and four bootstrap families independently recomputed from saved per-query arrays. Saved B2 bootstrap arrays and all184 ranking hashes verified. Raw scoring statuses are complete/DEV_SCORED/FINAL_SCORED; no tracker prose was consulted.

dead_code.details: All five evaluated scientific scoring paths call the shared metrics_for implementation and save its outputs. Matrix and prospective code flow from sealed ranking loads to metrics_for to per_query arrays to summaries. Gallery before/after paths use the same judged metric. No static-only metric is presented as executed. Audit does not claim an exhaustive dead-code scan of every unrelated utility.

scope.details: Four development collections x2 migrations x3 budgets x6 methods x5 mapping seeds, plus native references; one prospective171332-document/50-query collection. FiQA inspected-development status, query-level inference conditional on observed seeds and fixed collections, TREC geometric-baseline non-wins, no ANN/traffic/physical-cost claim and cached exposure semantics are disclosed. Unresolved intervals are not labeled equivalence.

evaluation_type.details: Reported nDCG and Recall for main matrix, ablations, all-paid, gallery diagnostics and prospective confirmation use real dataset judgments. Paid returned share is a deterministic label-free diagnostic of gallery composition. Synthetic smoke/metric sanity checks and the toy mechanism are expressly separate from scientific retrieval results.

limitations: No qrel files opened and no experiments executed. Retrieval metrics are checked against saved per-query outputs and scorer implementation, not freshly rescored labels.
No external paper/network consultation. Bibliography and related-work attribution require the separate citation review; this audit verifies empirical and algorithmic fidelity.

Upstream SimpleLinear raw source is not bundled locally; wrapper, locked official-source hashes, defaults and actual final-50 worker receipts are verified. Its architecture is supported by those provenance records rather than a fresh upstream-source audit.
Fresh same-family review is provisional, not cross-family acceptance.
